steps.title: A lambda
steps.say: `() -> ...` is a tiny method with no name. You're not running it now: you're handing it over to run later.

steps.title: A command
steps.say: `startEnd` runs one lambda when the command starts and another when it ends.

steps.title: Open ShooterCommands.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterCommands` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find Command shoot
steps.say: Below the comment that describes it. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `Command shoot` and press Enter to jump to it.
